# Controlled study — results (auto-generated by `kca.run.controlled_study`)

Attention-based 4D net trained per cue; motion-task val acc 1.000 ± 0.000 (3 seeds). Regions: correspondence-free tracked k-means (3 = the clusters). Decomposition vertex: static/moving point-mass proxy. Faithfulness scored on the target-class probability.

## 1. Faithfulness (Deletion-AUC, lower is better)
- Ranking (non-floor methods): point_drop 0.392, kca_ctx 0.399, kca 0.419, grad_x_input 0.482, smoothgrad 0.510, integrated_gradients 0.666, grad_cam_3d 0.689, attn_rollout 0.742, staa4d 0.742, extremal 0.880, occam 0.900
- Floors: random 0.907, geometry-edge 0.877, motion-prior 0.452.
- KCA (local) vs best other method `point_drop`: paired Wilcoxon p = 3.36e-02

## 2. Motion localisation (EBPG of Smot on the moving cluster)
- KCA 0.983 vs random 0.333.

- context estimator: motion-cue **1.00**, shape-cue **0.00** (gap 1.00).
